factors.name: Elevation
factors.meaning: Digital Elevation Model height above sea level. Low elevation basins retain surface runoff rapidly.
factors.preprocessing: Reproject to EPSG:4326, fill sinks via hydrologic DEM filtering, resample to 30m cell resolution.
factors.data_source: Source not connected — awaiting verified dataset
factors.nodata_rule: -9999 replaced with mean elevation of adjacent cells

factors.name: Slope
factors.meaning: Terrain incline angle. Flat terrain (0°-5°) restricts drainage speed, accelerating ponding.
factors.preprocessing: Derived from DEM using 3x3 Sobel directional gradient calculations.
factors.data_source: Source not connected — awaiting verified dataset

factors.name: Distance to River
factors.meaning: Euclidean spatial distance to primary river channels. Buffer zones < 500m face severe inundation risk.
factors.preprocessing: Euclidean distance raster grid calculation from polyline river networks.
factors.data_source: Source not connected — awaiting verified dataset

factors.name: Distance to Stream
factors.meaning: Proximity to secondary streams, canals, and seasonal drainage lines.
factors.preprocessing: Extract stream network from DEM using flow accumulation threshold > 1000 cells; compute distance raster.
factors.data_source: Source not connected — awaiting verified dataset

factors.name: Distance to Road
factors.meaning: Impervious transportation infrastructure blocking natural drainage networks.
factors.preprocessing: Euclidean distance grid from road polyline vectors.
factors.data_source: Source not connected — awaiting verified dataset

factors.name: Land Cover / LULC
factors.meaning: Land Use & Land Cover classification (Built-up, Waterbodies, Agriculture, Dense Forest).
factors.preprocessing: Reclassify satellite land cover classes to numerical impermeability ratings.
factors.data_source: Source not connected — awaiting verified dataset

factors.name: Aspect
factors.meaning: Compass direction slope faces (0°-360°), governing solar radiation and soil drying rates.
factors.preprocessing: Derived from DEM directional derivative vectors.
factors.data_source: Source not connected — awaiting verified dataset

factors.name: Topographic Wetness Index (TWI)
factors.meaning: twi = ln(a / tan b). Quantifies topographic control on hydrological processes and soil saturation.
factors.preprocessing: Compute specific catchment area (a) via D8 flow direction and divide by tangent slope (b).
factors.data_source: Source not connected — awaiting verified dataset

factors.name: Stream Power Index (SPI)
factors.meaning: spi = a * tan b. Measures erosive power of flowing surface water.
factors.preprocessing: Multiply specific catchment area by slope gradient.
factors.data_source: Source not connected — awaiting verified dataset

factors.name: Profile Curvature
factors.meaning: Curvature parallel to maximum slope direction. Governs flow acceleration or deceleration.
factors.preprocessing: Second-order spatial derivative of DEM parallel to flow.
factors.data_source: Source not connected — awaiting verified dataset

factors.name: Plan Curvature
factors.meaning: Curvature perpendicular to maximum slope direction. Governs flow convergence or divergence.
factors.preprocessing: Second-order spatial derivative of DEM perpendicular to flow.
factors.data_source: Source not connected — awaiting verified dataset
